events.text: LAYOUT RULING — fixed named regions: break the editor UI into primitively-named sections (Section A/B/C... — window chrome, action bar, focus panel, content browser, viewport, status bar). Each region is a FIXED-size panel: fixed width, fixed height, never shifts, never reflows with app state. ONLY the content inside swaps (outliner layers one moment, armed world piece the next). Consequence: anything rendered inside a region knows its exact available space as a CONSTANT — no component ever deduces free space from a chain of app-state reasoning. Content rules per region: (1) NO whole-panel scrolling; (2) nested scrolling inside sub-areas when needed; (3) paged assets instead of long scroll (the content browser already pages 1-1/1 style — that is the pattern); (4) content must VALIDATE its use of the fixed space — Image 62 shows a sparse readout floating in a huge dead panel; as the T4 metadata/rig/UV/slots data lands, budgeting that fixed height is paramount. User: these are design decisions that dont change how the app works under the hood but massively raise quality of life. IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE: one region-contract module (beside workspace.cls.ts) declaring each named region's dimensions as exported constants; panels mount into regions; content components import the region constants instead of measuring; T1-T5 UI work lands INTO this frame, so the region contract is step zero of the UI campaign, paired with the req_2626 laws (modal gate + control grid).

LANDED (wave 1, region agent): fixed-region contract committed as e2a4d1158. New cart/editor/shell/regions.ts = single source of truth (chrome h37, action bar h36, left rail w48, content browser w350/inner329, focus panel w326/body285/inner265, status h31, viewport = the one elastic region) + shared control grid (label 82, stepper 20, value 40, reset 18, rowH 21). workspace.cls.ts now reads REGIONS everywhere; never-wrap law baked in (numberOfLines:1 + loud ellipsis). ModelPaintVariants rebuilt on the grid (two-line Update chip GONE, header no longer wraps, bounded nested ScrollView for variants); ModelOutliner fixed 27px rows + capped nested scroll; MODEL FOCUS body no longer whole-panel-scrolls.
